userStories.title: [/app] Final: swap / redirect from /admin to /app

userStories.title: [/app] Move TaskChat to /app/tasks/{task}, replace polling with Reverb
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /app/tasks/{task}` returns 200 for task owner, 403 for non-owner
`TaskChat` component renders correctly inside the `/app` layout (not Filament shell)
No unconditional `wire:poll` on the chat root; updates arrive via Echo broadcast
AI response chunks appear in real-time in the chat window
Clicking a recent chat in the sidebar navigates to the correct task URL
Existing `TaskChatTest` and `TaskChatProviderTest` pass or are updated
Feature test: unauthenticated `GET /app/tasks/{task}` redirects to login

userStories.title: [/app] Move RecentChats to sidebar, replace polling with Reverb
acceptanceCriteria: `/app` sidebar shows the recent chats list for authenticated users

Creating or updating a Task causes the sidebar list to update in real-time without a page reload
Filament sidebar footer no longer renders the recent chats component (Filament unaffected otherwise)
Existing `RecentChatsTest` passes or is updated to reflect new wiring
Feature test: `RecentChatsUpdated` event causes component to refresh

userStories.title: [/app] Real-time: Install Laravel Reverb + Echo, define broadcast channels
acceptanceCriteria: `php artisan reverb:start` runs without errors
`BROADCAST_CONNECTION=reverb` is set and Laravel recognises Reverb as the driver

Private channels are defined and authorised for authenticated users only
All three broadcast event classes exist with correct channel and payload
Feature test: channel authorisation returns 200 for correct user, 403 for wrong user
